meta_title: Private DNS and Adapter DNS | VpnHood!
meta_description: Private DNS encrypts the lookup of website addresses so nobody on the network can see which sites you visit. In the VpnHood! apps.
title: Private DNS
lead: Encrypts the lookup of website addresses, so nobody on the network can see which sites you visit.
shot_alt: The Private DNS screen in the VpnHood! app
platforms: Private DNS is Android phones and tablets only, as it uses an Android system setting. Adapter DNS is available on every platform.
how_desc: Before your device can reach a site it asks a DNS server for the address, and that question normally travels in the clear. Private DNS encrypts it, closing a gap that can reveal your browsing even while a VPN is running.
when_desc: Worth leaving on permanently. It costs nothing you will notice and closes a common leak.
cost_desc: Nothing you will feel day to day.
